answer: Resist sybils with a per-epoch live liveness toll. Each identity must solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle seeded by an unforgeable public beacon inside a 30-second window, then post the proof to a shared vault. The seed is as unknowable-in-advance as a tundra dawn, so nothing precomputes; valid proofs sprout only in real time, like juniper rooting only where soil permits. One machine cannot fake a thousand simultaneous solves before the deadline, so every added sybil costs another full unit of real hardware work and cost scales linearly with genuine compute, not cheap cloned keys.
